resources.string: Starting a new notification reply generation does not restore old replies or prove this is a first installation. Missing history may mean lost storage. Existing retained text is not sent or reassociated. Create a separate new generation?
Notification reply generation setup is unavailable until durable storage policy and current-generation safeguards are integrated. Messaging and other notification settings remain available.
The warning was dismissed or interrupted. No acknowledgment is restored. An attempted action must be reconciled before starting another generation.
Setup is not confirmed or this foreground action is no longer current. Reconcile retained state; do not assume old replies were restored or a new generation was created.
The retained generation was observed as bound. This does not restore old replies or enable notification replies or message delivery.
